messages:
maria: FYI — scheduling a short rolling reboot for the eu-west1 GPU pool to apply NIC fw 1.2.7 and kernel micropatch. Window: Tue 04:00-07:00 UTC. Plan is cohort-based cordon+drain (10 nodes per cohort), then reboot + post-checks. Reserved/dedicated pools will be excluded.
raj: ETA on first cohort? any canary?
maria: first cohort = 04:10 UTC, 2-node canary to validate warmup + KV cache priming, then 10-node cohorts every 12m. Total ~6 cohorts. Canaries will be live-trafficked at low qps.
leo: network egress is my concern — when we backfill from us-west2, there will be inter-region repath. Can we pre-warm cross-region routes and increase egress caps to avoid timeouts?
maria: good call. plan: pre-warm prefix cache for common model checkpoints, and add temporary egress throttle exceptions for controller -> model-store. I'll open a short IP allowlist in cloud firewall for the window.
jess: Quick Q — what about Dedicated customers SLA? Are they routed away or will we keep capacity for them?
maria: Dedicated pools are excluded from the drain. Routing policy will prefer dedicated endpoints (customer routing tag) first. If capacity drops below committed throughput, fallback will go to alternative region (eu-west2) or to quantized variant (redwood-small) with a controlled degrade policy. We'll publish notice to affected accounts.
ops_oncall: Paging behaviour? if a node fails to come back or kubelet flaps, will that pager fire?
maria: yes — oncall will get paged for any cohort that doesn't reach Ready within 15m. We'll keep slack #oncall as primary channel and escalate to phone for >30m.
leo: Cost note — cross-region backfill might incur egress >$X/hr. Can we run a small sim with expected QPS and estimate?
raj: also check autoscaler max surge, we don't want it doing big scale-ups while nodes are cordoned. Suggest setting maxUnavailable instead of surge scaling during window.
maria: accepted. I'll patch the HPA/ClusterAutoscaler policy to set maxSurge=0 / maxUnavailable=5% for the window.
deploy-bot: scheduled: eu-west1-gpu-maintenance at 2026-03-24T04:00:00Z (ID: maint-1765123456) — canaries: node-eu-01,node-eu-02.
jess: For customer comms, Marketing will need impact bullets. maria can you share a 3-line summary we can paste?
maria: sure — "Planned rolling maintenance for eu-west1 GPU fleet on Tue 04:00-07:00 UTC to apply NIC & kernel fixes. Expected brief capacity reductions in bursts (~10-15%). Dedicated/reserved capacity unaffected; automated fallback to other regions for burst traffic. Oncall will monitor; contact support if you see >=2 min request errors."
raj: drain command for reference (will run from ops bastion):
```
kubectl cordon gpu-node-123 && kubectl drain gpu-node-123 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=1200
```
leo: will monitor egress and costs from my end. if we see unexpected spikes, I'll flip a throttling flag and notify.
ops_oncall: noted. I'll be on shift for the window and will escalate if any cohort stalls.
jess: acked, I'll draft the customer bulletin and post to #announcements by EOD.
maria: thanks everyone. I'll post a short post-mortem doc in #eng-infra after the window. :white_check_mark:
